items.prompt: You walk into a small shop in the morning. What do you say?
items.explanation: Dzień dobry is the formal hello for shops, offices and strangers.
optionNotes: Cześć is only for friends and family.
Dobranoc means good night, when you leave late or go to bed.
Na razie is an informal goodbye.

items.prompt: How do you ask a friend how they are?
items.explanation: The informal question is Jak się masz? It uses masz (have), not jesteś (are).
optionNotes: A calque of English 'how are you'; Polish uses masz here.
This is formal, for a man you don't know well.

items.prompt: Mam ___ imię Ewa. (My name is Ewa.)
items.explanation: The fixed phrase is Mam na imię … (literally 'I have the name …').

items.prompt: At noon you leave a meeting with a new client. What do you say?
items.explanation: Do widzenia is the formal goodbye.
optionNotes: Cześć is informal: friends and family only.
Dobranoc is for late in the evening.
